art_style: cinematic Korean drama, live-action drama series, photoreal narrative
lighting: soft diffused key with warm golden tones, blue-hour cool fill for melancholy, gentle halation on highlights
color_palette: pastel tones — soft pinks and creams, muted blues for melancholy, warm ambers for romance
camera_rules: slow push-in for emotional beats, rack focus between characters, subtle handheld drift only for tension; medium close-up for dialogue, extreme close-up for reaction; one move per clip
lens: 50mm cinematic, shallow DOF for close-ups, wide for establishing
post: soft film grain, slight desaturation, warm tone curve, gentle vignette
character_framing: medium close-up for dialogue, extreme close-up for emotional reactions
scene_transitions: slow dissolve, match cut on eye contact
